wooden_cottage_vanish_into_the_vines.label: Flattening against the left vines, rustling gently, then bursting out with a roar

wooden_cottage_rattle_the_door_studs.label: Rattling a quick tune along the low door studs with his bill

wooden_cottage_scratch_at_the_right_plan.label: Scratching soil out of the right planter with both feet until the flowers wobble

wooden_cottage_rock_the_little_tub.label: Rocking the little tub on its base with his shoulder to feel what is inside

wooden_cottage_tap_the_right_boards.label: Tapping the right boards from the ground up to hear which sound hollow

wooden_cottage_count_the_blossoms.label: Counting the blossoms across both planters and arriving at five, then six

wooden_cottage_measure_up_to_the_sill.label: Stretching up to the left sill to see how much of him reaches the ledge

wooden_cottage_compare_the_two_planters.label: Pacing from the left planter to the right and judging which has the better flowers

wooden_cottage_nibble_a_vine_leaf.label: Nibbling one vine leaf, chewing it solemnly, and writing it off as lettuce at best

wooden_cottage_listen_at_the_tub.label: Rapping the little tub and listening hard for what answers

wooden_cottage_lean_against_the_warm_pla.label: Leaning his back against the sun-warmed right planks and letting them hold him

wooden_cottage_sit_on_the_cottage_step.label: Sitting on the step with his wings folded and his thoughts elsewhere

wooden_cottage_sulk_at_the_left_vines.label: Hunching in a heap at the left vines with his back to the cottage

wooden_cottage_wait_by_the_lip.label: Waiting by the door lip for the resident, who has clearly gone for flowers

wooden_cottage_warm_feet_on_the_step.label: Warming each foot in turn against the sunlit step

wooden_cottage_prop_the_right_jamb.label: Propping the right jamb up with his shoulder like a bouncer who has seen things

wooden_cottage_kick_the_snow_off_the_lip.label: Kicking the snow drift off the lip and step in big swinging sweeps

wooden_cottage_scoop_snow_off_the_plante.label: Scooping the snow off the right planter in great wing-fulls

wooden_cottage_rake_the_leaf_litter.label: Raking the blown leaves against the foot of the left vines with both feet

wooden_cottage_cool_off_beside_the_plant.label: Flopping against the shady planter edge and fanning himself with both wings

wooden_cottage_shelter_at_the_left_jamb.label: Pressing flat against the left jamb with wings over his head while the rain drums

wooden_cottage_hold_the_window_shut_in_a.label: Pinning the left window frame shut with a wing while the gust tries it

wooden_cottage_skid_off_the_wet_step.label: Skidding off the wet step with his feet racing ahead of the rest of him

wooden_cottage_walk_into_the_vine_tangle.label: Marching confidently at the right vines and coming away wearing half of them

wooden_cottage_wing_tangled_in_the_vines.label: Catching a wing at the left vines and cartwheeling about until it comes free

wooden_cottage_crack_the_frame_with_a_pe.label: Pecking the window frame so hard the paint flakes and the board sighs

wooden_cottage_stub_a_toe_on_the_tub.label: Stubbing a toe against the little tub and spinning round in a rage

wooden_cottage_stamp_at_the_locked_door.label: Stamping at the door lip with his wings clamped when the latch ignores him

wooden_cottage_pose_between_the_planters.label: Posing at the threshold between both planters like a very well-off hobbit

wooden_cottage_bow_to_the_blossoms.label: Bowing slowly to the flowers on both sides as if they had applauded

wooden_cottage_present_the_cottage.label: Sweeping a wing along the cottage front like an agent who has never seen it

wooden_cottage_argue_with_the_tub.label: Arguing with the little tub, nose to rim, until it wins by going silent

wooden_cottage_serenade_the_left_window.label: Serenading the left window with a wing flung wide, no shame whatsoever

wooden_cottage_dance_a_jig_up_the_steps.label: Dancing a jig up the step and across the lip and down to the threshold
